description: Data on commercial, industrial, and residential electrical permits in the City of St. Louis

table:columns.name: APPDATE
table:columns.description: Date the permit application was filed.

table:columns.name: APPDESCRIPTION
table:columns.description: Free-text description of the permitted work.

table:columns.name: APPNUM
table:columns.description: Permit application number.

table:columns.name: APPTYPE
table:columns.description: Permit application type code; always 'AE' (Electrical) in this dataset — codes come from the city 'Permit Application Type' vocabulary (AB Building, AD Demolition, AE Electrical, AM Mechanical, AO Occupancy, AP Plumbing, etc.).

table:columns.name: CANCELDATE
table:columns.description: Date the application was cancelled, if it was.

table:columns.name: CANCELTYPE
table:columns.description: Cancellation code; only the value 'C' (cancelled) appears in the data and the city publishes no decode for it.

table:columns.name: CITYBLOCK
table:columns.description: City block number of the permitted parcel; PARCEL is the parcel number within the block, PARCEL9 the nine-digit CityBlock+Parcel root.

table:columns.name: COMPLETEDATE
table:columns.description: Date the permitted work was completed/finaled.

table:columns.name: ESTPROJECTCOST
table:columns.description: Estimated project cost in dollars as declared on the application.

table:columns.name: FIRSTDATE
table:columns.description: Date the record first appeared in the extract; LASTDATE is its last update (name-based).

table:columns.name: HANDLE
table:columns.description: Citywide parcel handle the permit is attached to (join key to the parcels collections).

table:columns.name: ISSUEDATE
table:columns.description: Date the permit was issued.

table:columns.name: MAINSTRUCTYPE
table:columns.description: Main structure type code, e.g. 1 One-or-Two Family, 2 Multi Family, 3 Hotel, 19 Industrial, 20 Commercial, 23 Garage (city 'Permit Structure Type' vocabulary); STRUCTYPE1-3 carry additional structure types.

table:columns.name: NBRHD
table:columns.description: City neighborhood number (city 'Neighborhood' vocabulary); ASRNBRHD is the assessor's neighborhood.

table:columns.name: NBROFUNITS
table:columns.description: Number of dwelling/occupancy units covered by the permit.

table:columns.name: OWNERCODE
table:columns.description: Taxing-status component of the parcel key (see parcels.OwnerCode decode).

table:columns.name: OWNERNAME
table:columns.description: Property owner of record at permit time (OWNERADDR/OWNERCITY/OWNERSTATE/OWNERZIP are the owner's mailing address).

table:columns.name: PRCLERR
table:columns.description: Parcel geocoding match/error code from the city's address-matching system (decode table CdPrclErr in the city's ComCode.mdb, e.g. 1-5 matches to non-LRMS addresses, 9 Outside City).

table:columns.name: PROJECTTYPE
table:columns.description: Project type code: 1 New Construction, 2 Addition, 3 Alteration, 4 Repair, 5 Replacement, 6 Demolition, 7 Occupancy, 8 Blasting, 9 Other (city 'Permit Project Type' vocabulary).

table:columns.name: UPDATEGEO
table:columns.description: Date/flag of the last geocoding update for the record (name-based).
